attestations.text: LIU Tsung-chou 劉宗周, (T. 起東, H. original name 憲章, H. 念臺, 克念, 蕺山), Mar. 4, 1578–1645, July 30, Ming philosopher and scholar, was a native of Shan-yin, Chekiang. A posthumous child, he was educated by his maternal grandfather, Chang Ying 章穎 (T. 叔魯, 南洲, d.
